title: Hof published-artifact acceptance evidence
description: Immutable record that a real acceptance run exercised one exact published candidate's own signed artifacts and either passed or failed. Consumed by the stable-promotion workflow as its gate - a candidate is never promoted to the stable channel without a schema-valid, succeeded evidence document that binds to the candidate's exact release-lock digest.

candidate.description: The immutable candidate tag the acceptance run downloaded and exercised.

release.description: The plain platform release version the candidate would promote to (candidate tag minus the -rc.N suffix).

commit.description: The exact hof-ops commit the candidate was built from.

releaseLockDigest.description: SHA-256 of the candidate's published release-lock.json, byte for byte. Promotion refuses unless this equals the digest of the release-lock.json actually attached to the candidate release.

executionEnvironmentDigest.description: The pinned Ansible Execution Environment image digest the candidate's release lock names, recorded so promotion can confirm acceptance ran the same EE the lock ships.

result.description: Overall outcome. A failed document is still published and retained for the audit trail; promotion refuses it.

scenarios.description: Every distinct source->restore acceptance scenario the run executed against published artifacts only.

acceptanceRunUrl.description: The GitHub Actions run that produced this evidence.
